notes: §2002:7.2.2 SR3: a fixed-form directive sits in the program-text area and only space characters and an inline comment may follow it. A directive from column 1 is refused, an inline comment after one is accepted, and a word after the format of every directive whose operand has a general format is COBOL1911 / COBOL1622. kb/Work PB5600 closed the one gap: FLAG-85 and FLAG-NATIVE-ARITHMETIC carried a Text operand the catalog never checked, so `>>FLAG-85 ALL ON JUNK` was accepted; both are now stage-owned rows parsed by FlagDirectiveLine (COBOL1622). PAGE's comment-text-1 is the only Text row left, and its format prints the text.
